source: Project Operating System Phase 3 - Testing Engine
description: Supported declarative test types for future phases.

items.description: Compares calculator inputs and outputs before and after a change.
Checks article structure, metadata and content integrity.
Checks SEO metadata, canonicals, indexability and URL stability.
Checks runtime dependencies remain safe and unchanged unless explicitly scoped.
Checks visible structure and layout-critical elements.
Checks load and interaction performance against baseline tolerance.
Checks offer-related placements, metadata and boundaries.
Checks future automation behavior against expected boundaries.

notes: Types are protocol labels only; no test runner is implemented in Phase 3.
